- **Recommendation**: (b) — the granule-fold keeps window-`Q` **additive by construction**, so every downstream invariant survives unchanged: the M7 counter key and single-writer, supersession continuity, T-D-12 `bandOffsetQ` slice math, package/volume band math, delta-only corrections (a late sample re-folds only its granule → `Q` delta → standard re-materialization). `last`/`unique` have no launch product and stay Future.
- **Decision**: **(b) (product call), 2026-07-16** — `aggregationFunction ∈ {sum (default), peak, time_weighted}` + `aggregationGranularity ∈ {hour (default), day}`, authorable on usage price rows, both frozen in `pricingSnapshotRef`. Non-`sum` rows: the meter is level-shaped (collector `gauge` kind); the sample unit is the level unit (GB, cloudlet), the billable `Q` unit is level·granule-hours (GB·h, cloudlet·h) — the SKU declares the **billable** unit (same doctrine as the composite output unit); publish validates sample-unit ↔ level-unit. Sampling-gap policy: `hold_last` bounded by a declared `maxHold`, beyond which the level reads 0 **and** an operator signal raises (fail-visible, never guessed) — `maxHold` value is Design-level. Non-`sum` MUST NOT co-occur with composite meters at launch (inputs stay window-sum). Joint Rating fixture required before publish of any non-`sum` row (AC #60-style). *Product-scope reversal — confirmed by the product owner 2026-07-16.* **Propagated**: PRD glossary/§15/§17.8 + DESIGN §4 + design/03 Q2 (this side); rating T-D-17 + PRD §6.5/§17.1 + design/03 §4.3 + design/12/13 (rating side); SEAMS M10 + UC6 updated. **Amendment 2026-07-28 (review fix — the catalog side had no design surface beyond Q2, and S3 `inst-tb-window` still said "window-sum only")**: S3 gains `algo-level-aggregation` (`inst-la-*`: authoring fields, gauge/unit publish check, **`maxHold` = authored `max_hold_granules` int ≥ 1, REQUIRED on non-`sum` rows** — the Design-level value D-44 delegated, fixture-gate variant, no composite co-occurrence), `pricing_price` columns (`aggregation_function`/`aggregation_granularity`/`max_hold_granules`), error codes `LEVEL_FIELDS_INVALID`/`LEVEL_UNIT_MISMATCH`/`LEVEL_COMPOSITE_FORBIDDEN`, `dod-level-aggregation`, ACs; `inst-tb-window` contradiction fixed; DESIGN §4 fixtures bullet gains `level-aggregation`.

#### D-45 [M] First-class `includedAllowance` in launch — publish-compiled (supersedes F-32)

- **Where**: PRD §1.4 (tier-row tail + new "Included allowance" glossary row), §6.10 `fr-included-allowance`, §15 F-32 row (re-decided), §17.8 row (→ Scope), AC #90a; [`DESIGN.md`](./DESIGN.md) §4 deferred list; [`design/03-price-structure.md`](./design/03-price-structure.md) Q6; [`design/10-advanced-primitives.md`](./design/10-advanced-primitives.md) D-45-consumer note.
- **Problem**: F-32 (2026-07-04) kept allowances as the `$0`-first-band workaround. Existing-SKU migration (2026-07-16) needs "N included, then rate" as a first-class fact: the band covers the math but not display ("includes N units") or reporting (included vs billed), and `rolloverPolicy` — cross-period state — is inexpressible in a stateless band. The floated stopgap (netting the allowance at the usage source / CT facade) violates the D-44 doctrine: the commercial rule must live in the catalog, sources emit raw usage.
- **Options**: (a) keep $0-band + facade-only labeling (no rollover, no reporting split); (b) first-class authored `includedAllowance` with **publish compilation** — `none` → $0 band + frozen marker, `carry` → D-43 per-period promotional grant; (c) a new rating-side allowance evaluator (new step machinery).
- **Recommendation**: (b) — first-class authoring with **zero new evaluation machinery**: band math and grant drawdown both already exist and are fixtured; the compiler is publish-time, deterministic, and frozen into the snapshot.
- **Decision**: **(b) (product call), 2026-07-16, confirmed** — `includedAllowance = {quantity N > 0 (billable units), rolloverPolicy {none (default), carry(maxPeriods ≥ 1)}}` on `usage` rows; publish compiles per the Glossary/FR rules; publish fails on non-`usage`, double-free ($0 band + allowance), non-`sum` rows (level-meter allowance Future — variable level·granule boundary), `quantity ≤ 0`; per-seat scaling = named Future gate. Rollover **execution** stays Billing-owned (D-43 drawdown order); rating is untouched by construction. **Propagated**: PRD glossary ×2 / FR / F-32 / §17.8 / AC #90a; DESIGN §4; design/03 Q6; design/10 note. **Amendment 2026-07-28 (review fix — the compiler had no design surface)**: S10 gains `algo-allowance-compile` (`inst-ac-*`: fail gate incl. the structural `package` exclusion, band compile = prepend `[0,N)` + offset authored bounds / two-band synthesis for untiered, frozen allowance marker `{quantity, rolloverPolicy, source}`, `carry` grant with compiled-only expiry form `periods(maxPeriods)`, deterministic replay), `AllowanceCompiler`, `pricing_price.included_allowance`, `ALLOWANCE_*` error codes, `dod-included-allowance`, ACs; `fr-included-allowance` added to S10 Traces-to + DESIGN slice row; design/03 `inst-tb-first` pre-D-45 wording fixed.

#### D-46 [M] Registry `sellable` flag + sellability-gate predicate 6

- **Where**: products gear PRD (`gears/bss/products/docs/PRD.md`): glossary "Sellable", `fr-sku-sellable`, mutability bucket iii, AC #2/#2a, provenance note; this PRD `fr-sellability-gate` (predicate 6 + component exemption); [`design/07-pricewindow-linkage.md`](./design/07-pricewindow-linkage.md) sellability DoD.
- **Problem**: `published` means *referenceable*, not *offerable*. Migrated catalogs carry technical/component SKUs that must exist, meter, and compose without ever being sold standalone; the only gates were plan/market-level (five predicates, `not_sellable_ga`) — no SKU-level field. The need was parked as a "CF Design-phase decision"; post upstream-detach the registry PRD is ours, so the decision lands here.
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-16, confirmed** — SKU-level `sellable` (default `true`; `false` = composition/metering-only), material-but-mutable (bucket iii, governed change, frozen per `CatalogVersion`); enforced as sellability-gate predicate **(6)** for **standalone** lines; bundle-**component** references exempt (the component conjunction stays (1)–(5), (6) applies to the bundle SKU itself). **Propagated**: products PRD (glossary/FR/mutability/AC 2+2a/provenance); pricing `fr-sellability-gate` (five→six); design/07 DoD; rating SEAMS §I RG3 closed alongside (first-substantive-edit rule).

#### D-47 [M] `CatalogVersion` increment taxonomy + batching SLO; SKU-retirement joint contract closed

- **Where**: this PRD §9.2 registry contract, `fr-read-model-propagation`/AC #95/§14/§17.5, §15 rows ×2; products PRD `fr-catalog-version-publish`, `fr-retirement-eol`.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 code-readiness review): the batched/discretionary publish **model** was decided 2026-07-04 but the trigger taxonomy and the SLO **value** stayed "open with Registry", and PRD text blocked publish-contract sign-off on them; the SKU-retirement joint contract likewise waited on "Registry to confirm". Post upstream-detach the registry (products gear) is vendored here — there is no external counterparty to wait for.
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-28** — taxonomy: **interactive** publish increments immediately (coalescing ≤ 5s); **bulk** (mass repricing, migrations, bulk enrollments) coalesces into one version, hard max delay **5 min**; SLO: **p95 pending→committed ≤ 60s, max 5 min**; registry stays the sole incrementer. Retirement joint contract closed by cross-reference: registry never retires under a referenced (or conservatively-referenced) `SkuReferenceCount` predicate; pricing flags + blocks new adoption per AC #82. **Propagated**: PRD §9.2 / AC #95 / §14 / §17.5 / §15 ×2; products PRD `fr-catalog-version-publish` + `fr-retirement-eol`.

#### D-48 [M] Billing joint lines pinned catalog-side (descriptor v1 five; G-4 drawdown placement)

- **Where**: this PRD §9.2 billing-descriptor contract + §15 row; [`design/10-advanced-primitives.md`](./design/10-advanced-primitives.md) `inst-pg-drawdown-placement`; rating `design/11` mirror; [STRIPE-GAP-ANALYSIS.md](./STRIPE-GAP-ANALYSIS.md) G-4.
- **Problem**: AC #53 required descriptor sufficiency with the field list TBD, and G-4 left the Billing-side continuation of the money order (where prepaid-grant drawdown sits relative to discounts/tax) unpinned — the last open gap-analysis item. No Billing gear doc exists yet to hold either.
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-28** — descriptor v1 = **invoice line template/labels, `taxCategory`, `glCode`, itemization rule, `billingTiming`** (additive-only extension); drawdown = **post-discount, pre-tax** — a credit reduces the charge, never pays the invoice (one doctrine with metered-`creditUnit` grants; Stripe parity), dormant at MVP (tax-exclusive) with an explicit **revisit checkpoint at Tax Engine GA**. Both carried catalog-side until Billing's gear PRD countersigns. **Propagated**: PRD §9.2 + §15; S10 `inst-pg-drawdown-placement`; rating design/11; gap analysis G-4 → actioned. **Amendment 2026-07-28 (review fix #6)**: the five-field contract's composition is now stated in one place — the descriptor-**set** entity keeps four fields (line template, tax category, GL code, itemization rule) and the fifth element, **`billingTiming`, rides each recurring price row** (a `pricing_price` column, validated by Slice 6's rule, delivered with the row); propagated to S2 P5/`inst-ds-required`/schema/DoD and the PRD FR + §9.2 + §17.3, which had drifted four-field.

#### D-49 [M] Product-defaults batch (launch posture for five §15 opens)

- **Where**: this PRD §15 rows ×5 (cancellation credits; cross-boundary sign-off; seats×usage; freemium flag; migration notice).
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 code-readiness review): five product-flavored opens all carried fail-safe defaults in the design but no recorded decision — each a potential re-litigation during implementation.

#### D-50 [H] PriceOverlay mutations are always material

- **Where**: [`design/05-governance.md`](./design/05-governance.md) `inst-mat-registered` + DoD; [`design/09-price-overlays.md`](./design/09-price-overlays.md) authoring flow RETURN step; PRD approval-threshold FR.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 design review, blocking #1): the `MaterialityEvaluator` computes per-row deltas over **price rows**; an overlay is not a price row, so with a threshold policy configured an overlay edit produced no delta → `auto_publishable`. Editing a `global`/`partner` line from −10% to −90% reached consumers with **no approver** (`price_overlay × write` only), while a $1 price-row change above threshold required two people.
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-28** — overlay creation, line add/remove, any line magnitude/kind change, and audience changes (scope/precedence/dating/disclosure) are **always-material registered triggers**: percent lines carry no currency and lines have no per-currency baseline, so the G1 no-delta fail-safe applies wholesale; the commit routes through the approval workflow before its D-06 publish unit fires. **Propagated**: S5 `inst-mat-registered` + materiality DoD; S9 flow; PRD FR.

#### D-51 [H] Retirement preserves in-flight coverage

- **Where**: [`design/11-lifecycle.md`](./design/11-lifecycle.md) `inst-rt-cancel` + `inst-re-cancelflow`; [`design/07-pricewindow-linkage.md`](./design/07-pricewindow-linkage.md) `inst-co-retirement-unwind` note.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 design review, blocking #2): retirement cancelled **every** not-yet-active window; a scheduled supersession successor `W2 = [t2, null)` was cancelled while active `W1 = [t0, t2)` ran to its natural end — every in-flight subscriber lost rateability from `t2` (arrears + renewals fail closed per `inst-ws-expire`; renewals are never gate-blocked, so they kept coming). `inst-fg-detect` only sees gaps *between* windows; D-05 had fixed exactly this trailing void, but only for live cutover units.
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-28** — retirement cancels scheduled windows **only for keys with no in-flight subscribers**; a key's continuing-coverage window is kept. Retirement stops **selling** (sellability-gate lifecycle predicate), never **rating**; the confirm screen labels kept vs cancelled windows. D-05's unwind composes (it restores predecessor coverage). **Propagated**: S11 `inst-rt-cancel`/`inst-re-cancelflow`; S7 unwind note.

#### D-52 [M] Grants are a table (`pricing_plan_grant`)

- **Where**: [`design/10-advanced-primitives.md`](./design/10-advanced-primitives.md) §6 + touches lists.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 design review #3): `inst-ac-carry` compiles a promotional grant **per allowance-carrying usage row**, but the schema held one `pricing_plan.prepaid_grant` jsonb and `pricing_grant_price` keyed by `plan_id` — a plan with two carry rows, or an authored grant plus one carry row, had nowhere to put the second grant.
- **Decision**: **2026-07-28** — `pricing_plan_grant` (PK `grant_id`, `source ∈ {authored, compiled_allowance}` with source `price_id` lineage); `pricing_grant_price` re-keyed on `grant_id`; D-43 field rules apply per grant row; compiled grants always `promotional`, never priced, recompiled never hand-edited. **Propagated**: S10 §6 schema + touches.

#### D-53 [M] Reservation on level rows: capacity flavor only at launch

- **Where**: [`design/10-advanced-primitives.md`](./design/10-advanced-primitives.md) `inst-rv-level` + §5 code; [`design/03-price-structure.md`](./design/03-price-structure.md) `inst-la-composite` cross-ref.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 design review #11): `inst-rv-tier-q` subtracts the matched reserved quantity from `Q`; under D-44 a non-`sum` `Q` is the sum of per-granule level folds, where "subtract" has no single meaning (per granule vs per window) — and reserved cloudlets metered peak-per-hour is a likely launch product.
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-28** — on non-`sum` rows only `reservationFlavor = capacity` is authorable (`capacityCharge = reservedRate × reservedQuantity` never touches `Q` — exactly the reserved-cloudlets shape); `consumption` fails publish (`LEVEL_RESERVATION_CONSUMPTION_FORBIDDEN`, 422) until per-granule netting semantics are decided (named Future gate); the reservation fixture gains a capacity-on-level scenario. **Propagated**: S10 `inst-rv-level` + §5; S3 cross-ref.

#### D-54 [M] `comparabilityRank` reverse guard

- **Where**: [`design/06-consumer-contracts.md`](./design/06-consumer-contracts.md) `inst-pc-mutual` + §5 code.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 design review #12): rank presence was validated only from the **source** plan's publish; a target offering no outbound changes could re-publish with `comparability_rank` NULL, leaving published inbound edges unclassifiable at read time — the same drift class D-23 exists to prevent (D-24 covers only retirement).
- **Decision**: **2026-07-28** — a plan referenced by any published `allowedChangeTargets` edge MUST NOT re-publish with its rank dropped (`COMPARABILITY_RANK_REVOKED`, 422, referencing plans enumerated); dropping the rank requires removing the inbound edges first or publishing a covering `PlanTier` ordering. **Propagated**: S6 `inst-pc-mutual` + §5.

#### D-55 [M] Rev-share requires `sum_of_parts` at launch

- **Where**: [`design/08-bundles.md`](./design/08-bundles.md) `inst-rs-sum` + key constraints; PRD `fr-bundle-composition` + §17.3 row.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 design review #13): rev-share sums per vendor SKU, but an `own_price` bundle has one bundle amount and no per-vendor-SKU revenue — no declared allocation base; Marketplace cannot accrue per SKU. The PRD claimed "rev-share and itemization are independent of the basis".
- **Decision**: **(product call), 2026-07-28** — rev-share is authorable on `sum_of_parts` bundles only; `own_price` + revShare fails publish (`REVSHARE_BASIS_UNSUPPORTED`, 422); lifting requires deciding an allocation base (e.g. component list prices) — a named Future gate. Bundles are p2, so this is a stated launch limitation, not a model change. Same review also fixed the residual-absorber typing: absorption is **per `(bundle, vendor SKU)` group** with a **party-typed** `residual_absorber_party` on the new `pricing_bundle_revshare_group` row (the bundle-level vendor-SKU absorber named a group, not a party), and `platform_cut_bp` moved to the group row. **Propagated**: S8 schema/algo/constraints; PRD FR + §17.3 + AC #23.

#### D-56 [H] Plan revision representation — draft-revision rows

- **Where**: [`design/01-foundation.md`](./design/01-foundation.md) §3.7 `pricing_plan` row + §4.3 `VersioningStore`; [`design/02-plan-definition.md`](./design/02-plan-definition.md) §6 `pricing_plan_phase.plan_revision` + §9 integration AC.
- **Problem** (2026-07-28 code-readiness review, blocking #1): Foundation said `pricing_plan` is "updated in place only through DraftStateMachine transitions" while S2's integration AC said "a published plan's shape change creates a new revision (append-only), never mutates in place" — and with a single mutable row, one `lifecycle_state`, and PATCH legal only in `draft`, a draft of revision N+1 had no defined place to live while revision N stayed published. The Foundation is the normative owner of the versioning mechanic and never specified the storage/authoring shape; `pricing_plan_phase.plan_revision` semantics were likewise undefined and, naively re-minting phase rows per revision, would have changed continuing rows' id-typed `phase` axis (D-19) and broken same-key supersession.
- **Decision**: **(review fix), 2026-07-28 — flagged for veto** — **draft-revision rows**: `pricing_plan` is keyed **`(plan_id, revision)`**; published revision rows are **immutable**; a shape change on a published plan opens a **new revision row in `draft`** (at most one open draft per plan — partial unique on `lifecycle_state = 'draft'`); the plan's identity, scope-key axes, and `pricing_price` attachment stay on `plan_id` (unchanged). Phase rows **re-attach** to the new revision with **stable `phase_id`** (never re-minted; `plan_revision` on the phase row = the revision that last (re-)attached it), preserving the `phase` axis and same-key supersession. In-place mutation survives only as state-machine `lifecycle_state` flips on a revision row — supersedes R-12's "`pricing_plan` mutable-in-place" clause to that extent. **Propagated**: Foundation §3.7 + §4.3; S2 phase-table note + stable-`phase_id` rule + integration AC.

## H. Tooling / traceability notes

- **cfs traceability exclusion for the design-slice sets (2026-07-28 review, finding 15).** The BSS multi-slice design sets (`gears/bss/*/docs/design/*.md` — pricing 12, rating 16, subscriptions 9 slices) are **deliberately outside cfs autodetect/traceability**: cfs hardcodes its artifact-kind set, so a `DESIGN_SLICE` kind cannot be registered via the kit manifest (attempted + reverted 2026-07-28), and a brace-glob on the DESIGN pattern breaks `DESIGN.md` matching. The slice docs follow the DESIGN template, declare `cpt-cf-bss-*` ids, and are review-audited (2026-07-22/28 waves) instead of cfs-validated. The exclusion itself is the `[[ignore]]` block in `.cf-studio/config/artifacts.toml`, which points here. **Revisit when cfs supports custom artifact kinds.**
